final_candidates.decision_summary: Glycine in the HA2 helical/stem region; G→A rigidifies the backbone and raises helix propensity with minimal steric risk, a well-established stabilizing strategy.
Conservative Gly→Ala in the HA2 stem near 'EDMGNGC'; adds a methyl group to restrict backbone flexibility and modestly increase folding stability.
Ala→Val in the HA2 coiled-coil region can fill hydrophobic core volume and improve packing/thermostability, tempered by slight overpacking risk.

stop_reason.detail: Top-3 stabilized after self-review; additional LLM-only rounds are unlikely to change ranking or confidence.

history.rationale: Glycine in the long HA2 stalk helix; Gly->Ala increases helix propensity and reduces backbone entropy, stabilizing the folded coiled-coil. Verified G at position 386.
Glycine in the HA2 hinge/helix region; G→A adds a methyl group that rigidifies the backbone and typically stabilizes helical structure without steric clashes.
Glycine near the membrane-proximal stem; Ala substitution should rigidify local backbone and modestly improve stem packing. Verified G at 465.
Glycine in the HA2 stem region (within 'EDMGNGC' area); conservative Gly→Ala substitution should slightly increase local helix propensity and stability.
Glycine in the C-terminal stem region; Gly->Ala adds hydrophobic bulk without introducing charge or steric clashes. Verified G at 479.
Near the C-terminal stem/transmembrane-adjacent region; stabilizing benefit plausible but proximity to membrane anchor makes the effect less predictable.
Alanine in the central helix bundle; Val can fill a small hydrophobic cavity and strengthen helix-helix packing if space permits. Verified A at 425.
Ala in HA2 coiled-coil region; A→V can fill hydrophobic core space and raise thermostability, but overpacking risk tempers confidence.
Ile->Leu is a conservative hydrophobic swap near the fusion-peptide proximal core that can improve side-chain packing geometry. Verified I at 339.
Very conservative hydrophobe swap; low risk but only marginal stability gain expected.
Glycine at the HA1/HA2 interface region of the stem; Ala increases local conformational rigidity. Verified G at 360.
Glycine near HA1/HA2 boundary; conservative substitution likely mildly stabilizing.
Serine in the stalk helix; removing a partially buried polar hydroxyl in favor of Ala can reduce desolvation penalty while retaining helix propensity. Verified S at 442.
Serine may participate in H-bonding in the stem; removal could destabilize or be neutral — weak rationale compared to Gly→Ala candidates.
